text:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert P-20260317-142 fired for service hosted-inference-prod (us-east-1) 1: sudden error budget burn: 5xx spike + queue depth surge. Trigger: error_rate > 150 and queue_length > 200 for 3m. Primary: Ravi S. Escalation: SRE-oncall -> Secondary -> Manager. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P-20260317-142 :rotating_light:
Ravi S: acked from laptop, I'm on it. seeing a lot of grpc RSTs in the edge logs.
PagerDutyBot: Primary acknowledged. If no mitigation within 5m, escalation will continue.
Ravi S: starting quick triage: checking autoscaler and pool health.
Tina L: pinged, joining. my phone is in DND for a meeting but will monitor Slack.
Carlos G: I can open a read-only bridge, putting logs there: https://meet.internal/bridge/hosted-142
Ravi S: autoscaler shows scale-up attempts failing with "max replicas reached" counter. Looks like the autoscaler didn't update limit after yesterday's deploy.
Tina L: are we hitting a user-triggered A/B rollout? I saw a config change that bumped concurrency in the experiments service at 18:40 UTC.
Ravi S: yes experiments increased client concurrency; combined with autoscaler limit we're overloaded; queue grows -> backend timeouts -> retries -> more load.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty escalation: primary acknowledged but incident persists; secondary Tina L paged.
Tina L: acked. I'm enabling temporary throttling on experiments service to curb traffic; applying a rate-limit rule.
Tina L: patch:```bash
# apply quick rate limit via gateway
curl -X PATCH https://gateway.internal/api/rate-limits/experiments -d '{"limit":1000}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Tina L: rate-limit applied, traffic dropped ~60% at the gateway. queue_length declining. monitoring.
Ravi S: in parallel I'm bumping autoscaler max from 50 -> 150 to let pods scale if needed. doing via infra CLI.
Ravi S: ```bash
infractl autoscaler update --service hosted-inference-prod --max 150
```
Carlos G: I see pods coming up but one node shows OOMKilled events for model-worker-3; looks like a memory regression in the model runtime (new allocator).
Tina L: rolling an emergency small-scale rollback of the allocator library on model-worker image to the previous stable tag (tag: model-runtime:v2.3.7).
Tina L: rollback pushed, new pods pulling.
Ravi S: queue and 5xx rate dropping steadily from 380 -> 70 in last 6 minutes. p99 latency still elevated but improving.
PagerDutyBot: Incident P-20260317-142 updated: mitigations applied (gateway throttling + autoscaler bump + runtime rollback). Error rate reduced 80%.
IncidentBot: because the secondary acknowledged and mitigation progressed, manager paged due to escalation policy for visibility.
Manager-Jen: awake, joining. thanks for the quick actions. keep the bridge open 20m and prepare a short customer-facing blurb.
Ravi S: customer impact: increased latency and some failed requests for ~14 minutes for a subset of customers using experiments flag. No data loss. notifying account teams now.
Carlos G: follow-ups: add deploy check that validates autoscaler max wasn't accidentally left at low value; create test that simulates client-side concurrency bump.
Tina L: also revert the allocator change entirely and add canary step to rollout pipeline.
Ravi S: I'll file the incident ticket and draft the postmortem. timeline: first alert 1766004321 -> throttling 1766004430 -> autoscaler bump 1766004520 -> rollback 1766004620 -> mitigated 1766004720.
IncidentBot: Incident P-20260317-142: mitigated by Tina L. Pager closed after 9m.
Manager-Jen: good work. retro scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Ravi/Tina/Carlos please add action owners to the ticket. :thumbsup:
